messages.author: e803483734a6a2a7
messages.subject: installation issue on Windows
parts:
Hello,

I'm following the installation page (R-INLA Project - Download & Install) and am encountering the following error: 

remotes::install_version("INLA", version = "25.06.13",
+                          repos = c(getOption("repos"), INLA = "https://inla.r-inla-download.org/R/testing"), dep = TRUE)

Downloading package from url: https://inla.r-inla-download.org/R/testing/src/contrib/INLA_25.06.13.tar.gz
Skipping 2 packages not available: graph, Rgraphviz
* installing *binary* package 'INLA' ...
cp: unknown option -- )
Try '/usr/bin/cp --help' for more information.
ERROR: installing binary package failed

I do have graph and Rgraphviz packages installed. I'd appreciate any help, thank you. 

Best,
Andrew

messages.author: 3eab71733027a24a
messages.subject: Re: [r-inla] installation issue on Windows
parts:
Using R-4.5 ? 

Seems like it grabs the source version and not the bin one….

You can download manually from 

https://inla.r-inla-download.org/R/testing/bin/windows/contrib/4.5/

And then install locally?

—
Haavard Rue
Helpdesk
he...@r-inla.org
